def apply_format_to_elements(list_, string):
    """
    Apply a format string to each element in a list.

    Args:
        list_: An iterable of values to format.
        string: A format string (e.g. "{0}") applied to each element.

    Returns:
        A list of formatted strings.
    """
    return [string.format(i) for i in list_]


# Example usage / self-test
if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = apply_format_to_elements([1.234, 5.678, 9.012], "{0:.2f}")
    assert result == ["1.23", "5.68", "9.01"]
    assert apply_format_to_elements(["temp1", "temp2", "temp3", "temp4"], "{0}")[-1] == "temp4"
    print(result)
